description: Source code for ICM42605 sensor driver setup, including configuration, initialization, and FIFO control functions.

methods.name: icm42605_set_fs
methods.description: Sets the full scale range for accelerometer and gyroscope.

methods.name: icm42605_set_odr
methods.description: Sets the output data rate for accelerometer and gyroscope.

methods.name: icm42605_sensor_init
methods.description: Initializes the ICM42605 sensor, including reset and configuration.

methods.name: icm42605_turn_on_fifo
methods.description: Enables and configures FIFO for sensor data collection.

methods.name: icm42605_turn_off_fifo
methods.description: Disables FIFO and resets related configurations.

methods.name: icm42605_turn_on_sensor
methods.description: Starts the sensor, including setting full scale and ODR, and enabling FIFO.

methods.name: icm42605_turn_off_sensor
methods.description: Stops the sensor and disables FIFO.
